g.text: Title: BQ25798 charger, power path and pack connector

g.desc: Title: BQ25798 charger, power path and pack connector

g.text: Sheet: /BQ25798 charger, power path and pack connector/

g.desc: Sheet: /BQ25798 charger, power path and pack connector/

g.text: POWER (hold 1 s: on; 10 s: system reset)

g.desc: POWER (hold 1 s: on; 10 s: system reset)

g.text: Q400 between pack and BAT, source on the charger side: its body diode blocks pack discharge in ship mode. BATP senses the pack side through 100R.

g.desc: Q400 between pack and BAT, source on the charger side: its body diode blocks pack discharge in ship mode. BATP senses the pack side through 100R.

g.text: VBUS: 1 x 10 uF + 100 nF, so total VBUS bulk with C321 stays near the USB Type-C 10 uF sink limit (TI minimum 2 uF effective). PMID: 3 x 10 uF + 100

g.desc: VBUS: 1 x 10 uF + 100 nF, so total VBUS bulk with C321 stays near the USB Type-C 10 uF sink limit (TI minimum 2 uF effective). PMID: 3 x 10 uF + 100

g.text: STAT LED lit from REGN (USB present): on while charging, 1 Hz blink on fault. POWER drives QON; BAT54 gives the MCU a 3.3 V-safe copy

g.desc: STAT LED lit from REGN (USB present): on while charging, 1 Hz blink on fault. POWER drives QON; BAT54 gives the MCU a 3.3 V-safe copy

g.text: 5 x 22 uF X7R + 100 uF OS-CON + 100 nF. Step 10 needs >= 24 uF effective at average load (aim 127 uF) so SYS_OK resets the ADC before AVDD leaves regulation.

g.desc: 5 x 22 uF X7R + 100 uF OS-CON + 100 nF. Step 10 needs >= 24 uF effective at average load (aim 127 uF) so SYS_OK resets the ADC before AVDD leaves regulation.

g.text: off whenever the MCU is not running.

g.desc: off whenever the MCU is not running.

g.text: data sheet; service or disable the 40 s watchdog (on expiry the hardware ceiling returns).

g.desc: data sheet; service or disable the 40 s watchdog (on expiry the hardware ceiling returns).

g.text: Layout: follow the TI layout guide - VBUS/PMID/SYS/BAT capacitors and the 100 nF parts at the pins, short SW1/SW2 loop, BATP Kelvin to the pack side of Q400. Keep the converter away from the electrode

g.desc: Layout: follow the TI layout guide - VBUS/PMID/SYS/BAT capacitors and the 100 nF parts at the pins, short SW1/SW2 loop, BATP Kelvin to the pack side of Q400. Keep the converter away from the electrode

g.text: PROG 6.04k: 2S, 1.5 MHz. ILIM_HIZ = REGN x 10/37: hardware input ceiling about 0.37 A (max 0.44 A), below the 500 mA USB default. TS: 5.23k/30.1k window for a 103AT NTC

g.desc: PROG 6.04k: 2S, 1.5 MHz. ILIM_HIZ = REGN x 10/37: hardware input ceiling about 0.37 A (max 0.44 A), below the 500 mA USB default. TS: 5.23k/30.1k window for a 103AT NTC

g.text: CE low enables charging. R406 holds CE high from REGN; Q401 pulls it low only while CHARGE_REQUEST is high, so charging stays

g.desc: CE low enables charging. R406 holds CE high from REGN; Q401 pulls it low only while CHARGE_REQUEST is high, so charging stays

g.text: Firmware: read TUSB320 advertised current, then set EN_EXTILIM = 0 and IINDPM to the allowed budget; disable AUTO_INDET_EN (D+/D- not connected); set ICHG 0.5 A, VREG 8.4 V, JEITA limits from the pack

g.desc: Firmware: read TUSB320 advertised current, then set EN_EXTILIM = 0 and IINDPM to the allowed budget; disable AUTO_INDET_EN (D+/D- not connected); set ICHG 0.5 A, VREG 8.4 V, JEITA limits from the pack

g.text: On battery the BQ25798 does not switch: its battery FET connects the pack to SYS. With USB present it powers SYS and charges the pack; SERVICE_OK keeps the ADC off.

g.desc: On battery the BQ25798 does not switch: its battery FET connects the pack to SYS. With USB present it powers SYS and charges the pack; SERVICE_OK keeps the ADC off.

g.text: 1.0 uH for the 1.5 MHz setting (TI: 1.5 MHz requires 1 uH). Isat must exceed the input or charge current plus half

g.desc: 1.0 uH for the 1.5 MHz setting (TI: 1.5 MHz requires 1 uH). Isat must exceed the input or charge current plus half

g.text: nF. 100 nF parts at the pins.

g.desc: nF. 100 nF parts at the pins.

g.text: Soft-off: firmware writes SDRV_CTRL = 10 (ship mode); Q400 opens and the whole board, supervisor dividers included, loses power. Hold POWER 1 s or plug USB to wake. Holding POWER 10 s forces a system

g.desc: Soft-off: firmware writes SDRV_CTRL = 10 (ship mode); Q400 opens and the whole board, supervisor dividers included, loses power. Hold POWER 1 s or plug USB to wake. Holding POWER 10 s forces a system

g.text: D+/D- unconnected: USB data stays with the MCU.

g.desc: D+/D- unconnected: USB data stays with the MCU.

g.text: Single input on VBUS: VAC1/VAC2 tied to VBUS and ACDRV1/2 to GND (no input FETs).

g.desc: Single input on VBUS: VAC1/VAC2 tied to VBUS and ACDRV1/2 to GND (no input FETs).

g.text: BQ25798 2S CHARGER, POWER PATH, SHIP FET AND PACK CONNECTOR - CHARGE ONLY WITH ELECTRODES DISCONNECTED

g.desc: BQ25798 2S CHARGER, POWER PATH, SHIP FET AND PACK CONNECTOR - CHARGE ONLY WITH ELECTRODES DISCONNECTED
